```{r formulae, echo= FALSE}

normalize_fips <- function(x) {
  digits <- stringr::str_extract(as.character(x), "\\d+")
  digits <- ifelse(is.na(digits) | digits == "", NA_character_, digits)
  ifelse(is.na(digits), NA_character_, stringr::str_pad(digits, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0"))
}
```

```{r waiver_ingest, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}

## Waivers

waiver_files <- list.files(
 waiver_dir,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE) |>
  sort()

## Geography crosswalk: State, County to FIPS

## First, ingest the county crosswalk
geo <- readr::read_csv(county_crosswalk_dir, 
                       col_names = c("STATE", "STATEFP", "COUNTYFP", "COUNTYNAME", "CLASSFP"), # Columns to keep
                       show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              mutate(
              STATEFP = stringr::str_pad(as.character(STATEFP), width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0"),
              COUNTYFP = stringr::str_pad(as.character(COUNTYFP), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0") # Pad strings before merge
            ) |>
  transmute(
    STATE = STATE,
    COUNTYNAME = COUNTYNAME,
    FIPS = paste0(STATEFP, COUNTYFP) # Create 5 digit FIPS
  ) |>
      mutate(
      COUNTYNAME = COUNTYNAME |>
        str_to_lower() |>
        str_to_title() |>
        str_replace_all("City County", "City")
    )



# --- Create "Wide" File with month-year columns

generated_wide <- waiver_files |>
  map(readxl::read_excel) |>
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(
     DATE_START = as.Date(DATE_START),
    DATE_END = as.Date(DATE_END)
  ) 

months_between <-
  format(
    seq(from = min(as.yearmon(generated_wide$DATE_START), na.rm = TRUE), to = max(as.yearmon(generated_wide$DATE_END), na.rm = TRUE), by = 1 /12), "%b_%Y"
  )

for (month_column in months_between) {
  generated_wide[[month_column]] <- 0L
 }

# --- Using the newly created month columns, populate with an indicator for each row depending on waiver status

  for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(generated_wide))){
    active_months <- format(
      seq(from = as.yearmon(generated_wide$DATE_START[[row_index]]), to = 
          as.yearmon(generated_wide$DATE_END[[row_index]]), by = 1/12), "%b_%Y"
    )
    
    if (length(active_months) > 0) {
      generated_wide[row_index, active_months] <- 1L
    }
  }

# --- Transform from Wide to Longm with a month_date column that explains 

generated_long <- generated_wide |>
  select(YEAR, STATE, STATE_ABBREV, ENTIRE_STATE, LOC, LOC_TYPE, DATE_START, DATE_END, SOURCE_DOC) |>
    mutate(
    DATE_START = as.Date(DATE_START),
    DATE_END = as.Date(DATE_END)
  ) |>
  rowwise() |> # Create one row per month date combination for each loc
  reframe(
    across(everything()),
    MONTH_DATE = seq.Date(
      from = DATE_START,
      to = DATE_END, 
      by = "month"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    YEAR = year(MONTH_DATE)
  ) |>
    mutate( #Clean up LOC names
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bBiaden\\b", "Bladen"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bBighorn\\b", "Big Horn"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bCarterel\\b", "Carteret"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bCentra Costa\\b", "Contra Costa"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bDublin\\b", "Duplin"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bFemont\\b", "Fremont"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bIona\\b", "Ionia"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bLunenberg\\b", "Lunenburg"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bMclean\\b", "McLean"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bRollette\\b", "Rolette"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bTiaga\\b", "Tioga"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bUpsher\\b", "Upshur"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bWyth\\b", "Wythe"),
    LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "\\bBaltimore City\\b", "Baltimore")
    ) |>
      mutate(
      LOC = LOC |>
        str_to_lower() |>
        str_to_title(),
      LOC = if_else(LOC_TYPE == "County", paste(LOC, "County"), LOC),
      LOC = str_replace_all(LOC, "City County", "City"),
      LOC = case_when(
        LOC == "Petersburg County" & STATE_ABBREV == "VA" ~ "Petersburg City",
        LOC == "Williamsburg County" & STATE_ABBREV == "VA" ~ "Williamsburg City",
        LOC == "Martinsville County" & STATE_ABBREV == "VA" ~ "Martinsville City",
        TRUE ~ LOC
      )
    )

# --- Expand entire-state waivers to county-level rows

## Join generated long with Geo to pull in FIPS to expand state level waivers to county rows

state_rows <- generated_long |>
  filter(ENTIRE_STATE == 1) |>
  left_join(geo, by = c("STATE_ABBREV" = "STATE"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(
    LOC = COUNTYNAME, 
    LOC_TYPE = "County",
    waiver_scope = "statewide"
  ) |>
  select(-COUNTYNAME)


# sanity check - how many county or county equivalents are in each    
#state_rows |>
#  mutate(year = lubridate::year(MONTH_DATE)) |>
#  distinct(year, FIPS) |>
#  count(year) -> x

# --- Connect County-level waivers to FIPS codes

county_rows <- generated_long |>
  filter(LOC_TYPE == "County") |>
  left_join(geo, by = c("LOC" = "COUNTYNAME", "STATE_ABBREV" = "STATE")) |>
  mutate(waiver_scope = "substate")

# --- Handle all non-county, non-statewide rows

other_rows <- generated_long |>
  filter(LOC_TYPE != "County", ENTIRE_STATE != 1) |>
  mutate(
    FIPS = NA_character_,
    waiver_scope = "substate"
  )

# --- Recombine standardized waiver rows into the final generated long panel

generated_long <- bind_rows(other_rows, county_rows, state_rows) |>
  mutate(FIPS = normalize_fips(FIPS)) |>
  arrange(STATE_ABBREV, LOC, MONTH_DATE, SOURCE_DOC)

rm(county_rows, other_rows, state_rows, active_months,crounty_crosswalk_dir, month_column, months_between, row_index, waiver_dir, waiver_files)
  

```

```{r covariate_SNAP_retailer_prep, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
# Prepare the SNAP covariate panel before merging with generated_long

library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(stringr)


## Ingest SNAP retailer data

snap <- data.table::fread(snap_path, encoding = "UTF-8") |>
  mutate(`Store Name` = str_to_lower(trimws(`Store Name`)),
         County = toupper(trimws(County)),
         State = toupper(trimws(State)),
         chain = "placeholder")

## Modify geo to match the naming practices used in the SNAP retailer panel 

geo |>
  mutate(county = COUNTYNAME |> str_trim() |> str_to_upper(),
         county_fips = FIPS,
         state_id = STATE) |>
  select(county, county_fips, state_id) |> 
  mutate(county = str_remove(county,
  " (CITY AND BOROUGH|COUNTY|PARISH|BOROUGH|CENSUS AREA|MUNICIPALITY)$")) -> county

rm(geo)

## create store patterns 

store_patterns <- c(
  "dollar general" = "dollar general",
  "dollar tree" = "dollar tree",
  "family dollar" = "family dollar",
  "7-eleven" = "seven eleven",
  "circle k" = "circle k",
  "speedway" = "speedway",
  "albertsons" = "albertsons",
  "aldi" = "aldi",
  "bashas markets" = "bashas markets",
  "delhaize america" = "delhaize america",
  "fred meyer" = "fred meyer",
  "giant eagle" = "giant eagle",
  "giant food" = "giant food",
  "great a & p tea co" = "great a & p tea co",
  "he butt" = "he butt",
  "hannaford bros" = "hannaford bros",
  "hy vee food stores" = "hy vee food stores",
  "ingles markets" = "ingles markets",
  "kroger" = "kroger",
  "lone star funds" = "lone star funds",
  "publix" = "publix",
  "raley's" = "raley's",
  "roundy's" = "roundy's",
  "ruddick corp" = "ruddick corp",
  "safeway" = "safeway",
  "save a lot" = "save a lot",
  "save mart" = "save mart",
  "smart & final" = "smart & final",
  "stater bros" = "stater bros",
  "stop & shop" = "stop & shop",
  "supervalu" = "supervalu",
  "trader joe's" = "trader joe's",
  "weis markets" = "weis markets",
  "whole foods" = "whole foods",
  "wild oats" = "wild oats",
  "winn-dixie" = "winn-dixie",
  "meijer" = "meijer",
  "target" = "target",
  "wal.*mart" = "wal-mart",
  "bj's" = "bj's",
  "costco" = "costco",
  "sam's club" = "sam's club"
)

# --- Match retailer names to known chain patterns

for (pattern in names(store_patterns)) {
  snap[grepl(pattern, `Store Name`, ignore.case = TRUE), chain := store_patterns[[pattern]]]
}

# --- Classify remaining unmatched stores by broad store type

snap[`Store Type` == "Convenience Store" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "convenience_store"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Supermarket" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "super_market"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Farmers' Market" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "farmers_market"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Large Grocery Store" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "large_grocery"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Medium Grocery Store" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "medium_grocery"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Small Grocery Store" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "small_grocery"]
snap[`Store Type` == "Fruits/Veg Specialty" & chain == "placeholder", chain := "produce"]

snap <- snap |>
  mutate(
    dollarStore = str_detect(
      `Store Name`,
      "dollar tree|dollar general|family dollar"
    ),
    chain = paste0("chain_", chain),
    chain = str_replace_all(chain, "[' ]", "_")
  ) |>
  filter(chain != "chain_placeholder")

# --- Merge SNAP retailer panel with list of FIPS codes

snap <- snap |>
  left_join(
    county |> 
      transmute(
        County = county,
        State = state_id,
        county_fips = county_fips
      ),
    by = c("County", "State")
  )

# --- Standardize dates, retailer authorization windows

snap <- snap |>
  mutate(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    `Authorization Date` = as.Date(
      `Authorization Date`,
      format = "%m/%d/%Y"
    ),
    `End Date` = as.Date(
      `End Date`,
      format = "%m/%d/%Y"
    ),
    authorization_year = year(`Authorization Date`),
    end_year = year(`End Date`),
    end_year = if_else(
      is.na(end_year),
      2024L,
      end_year
    )
  )

# --- Correct repeated authorization records before constructing outcomes

# IMPORTANT CORRECTION:
# The historical SNAP retailer file is organized at the authorization-spell
# level, not at the unique physical-store level. A single `Record ID` can
# therefore appear on multiple rows with different authorization dates. The
# uncorrected workflow counted every one of those rows as a separate entry and
# expanded every spell into the active-store stock. That caused one store to be
# counted multiple times in both the flow and stock outcomes.

# Keep the complete spell-level `snap` object unchanged so that repeated
# authorizations remain available for inspection. The audit below identifies
# Record IDs with multiple beginning authorization dates and reports how many
# additional spell rows would have entered the uncorrected flow construction.

repeated_authorization_audit <- snap |>
  group_by(`Record ID`) |>
  summarise(
    authorization_rows = n(),
    distinct_authorization_dates = n_distinct(`Authorization Date`),
    first_authorization_date = min(`Authorization Date`, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_authorization_date = max(`Authorization Date`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    distinct_authorization_dates > 1
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(distinct_authorization_dates),
    `Record ID`
  )

authorization_correction_summary <- snap |>
  summarise(
    authorization_spell_rows = n(),
    unique_record_ids = n_distinct(`Record ID`),
    missing_record_ids = sum(is.na(`Record ID`)),
    missing_authorization_dates = sum(is.na(`Authorization Date`)),
    additional_spell_rows = n() - n_distinct(`Record ID`),
    record_ids_with_multiple_dates = nrow(repeated_authorization_audit)
  )

authorization_correction_summary
repeated_authorization_audit

# FLOW CORRECTION:
# Define physical entry as the earliest observed authorization for each unique
# Record ID. Sorting before `distinct()` makes the selection rule explicit and
# reproducible. This step occurs before the 2014--2019 filter so that a store
# first authorized before the analysis window cannot re-enter the flow merely
# because it has a later reauthorization during the analysis period.

snap_first_authorization <- snap |>
  arrange(
    `Record ID`,
    `Authorization Date`,
    `End Date`
  ) |>
  distinct(
    `Record ID`,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Confirm that the corrected flow source contains exactly one row per Record
# ID. This is an audit check only; it does not alter any outcome values.

snap_first_authorization |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_record_ids = n_distinct(`Record ID`),
    one_row_per_record_id = rows == unique_record_ids
  )

# STOCK CORRECTION:
# Expand every authorization spell to the years in which it is active, but
# retain `Record ID` through the expansion. Multiple spells for the same store
# may overlap or fall within the same calendar year. After sorting, retain only
# one row for each Record ID-year. Thus, a store is counted once in a county-year
# if any of its authorization spells indicate that it was active in that year.
# When multiple spell rows exist for the same Record ID-year, the earliest
# authorization spell supplies its county and retailer-category information.

store_year_spells <- snap |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`Record ID`),
    !is.na(county_fips),
    !is.na(authorization_year),
    !is.na(end_year)
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  reframe(
    `Record ID`,
    county_fips,
    chain,
    `Authorization Date`,
    `End Date`,
    year = seq.int(
      from = authorization_year,
      to = end_year
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Report the number of expanded spell-year rows that the uncorrected stock
# construction would count, alongside the number of unique store-years that
# remain after enforcing one observation per Record ID-year.

store_year_correction_summary <- store_year_spells |>
  summarise(
    authorization_spell_year_rows = n(),
    unique_record_id_years = n_distinct(`Record ID`, year),
    duplicate_spell_year_rows = n() - n_distinct(`Record ID`, year)
  )

store_year_correction_summary

store_count <- store_year_spells |>
  arrange(
    `Record ID`,
    year,
    `Authorization Date`,
    `End Date`
  ) |>
  distinct(
    `Record ID`,
    year,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) |>
  count(
    county_fips,
    chain,
    year,
    name = "count"
  )

rm(store_year_spells)

```


```{r acs_covariates, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
## Pull the ACS Covariates by county from Census API

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(tidycensus)

# -- Define County Scope

excluded_state_fips <- c(
    "02", # Alaska
  "15", # Hawaii
  "60", # American Samoa
  "66", # Guam
  "69", # Northern Mariana Islands
  "72", # Puerto Rico
  "74", # U.S. Minor Outlying Islands
  "78"  # U.S. Virgin Islands
)

county_scope <- county |>
  mutate(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    state_fips = substr(county_fips, 1, 2), #first 2 digits are state ID 
    state_abbrev = state_id
  ) |>
    distinct(
    county_fips,
    state_fips,
    state_abbrev
  ) |>
  filter(
    !(state_fips %in% excluded_state_fips)
  ) |>
  arrange(county_fips)

# -- Read/Register API Key

census_api_key <- readLines(
  api_key_path,
  warn = FALSE
) |>
  str_trim()

census_api_key <- census_api_key[
  census_api_key != ""
][[1]]

Sys.setenv(
  CENSUS_API_KEY = census_api_key
)

# -- Define ACS/Analysis Year

acs_year <- 2013L

analysis_years <- 2014:2019

# -- Define the ACS variables used in the current pipeline

acs_variables <- c(
  "B20002_001", # Median earnings; currently stored as meanInc and income
  "B11001_001", # Total households
  "B25064_001", # Median gross rent
  "B23025_003", # Civilian labor force
  "B23025_005"  # Unemployed
)

# -- Pull 2014 ACS 5-year county estimates

acs_2014_raw <- tidycensus::get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = acs_variables,
  year = acs_year,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = FALSE,
  output = "wide",
  cache_table = TRUE
)

# -- Join the ACS pull to the retained county scope

acs_2014 <- county_scope |>
  left_join(
    acs_2014_raw |>
      mutate(
        county_fips = normalize_fips(GEOID)
      ),
    by = "county_fips"
  )

# -- Construct the ACS covariates

acs_2014 <- acs_2014 |>
  transmute(
    county_fips,
    state_fips,
    state_abbrev,
    acs_source_year = acs_year,
    totalHH = as.numeric(B11001_001E),
    medianInc = as.numeric(B20002_001E),
    num_households = as.numeric(B11001_001E),
    rent = as.numeric(B25064_001E),
    civilian_labor_force = as.numeric(B23025_003E),
    unemployed = as.numeric(B23025_005E),
    urate = if_else(
      is.na(civilian_labor_force) | civilian_labor_force == 0,
      NA_real_, unemployed/civilian_labor_force
    )
  )

# -- Keep the 2014 wage observation for each county

wages_2014 <- readr::read_csv(
  wages_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    wage = as.numeric(wage)
  ) |> 
  filter(year == acs_year) |>
  select(county_fips, wage)

# -- Combine the 2014 ACS and wage covariates

baseline_covariates <- acs_2014 |>
  left_join(
    wages_2014, by = "county_fips"
  ) |>
  group_by(state_fips) |> #Fill in N/A with state average wage - ask Alejandro why we have ~800 N.A
  mutate(
     mean_2014_wage = mean(
      wage,
      na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
      wage = if_else(
      is.na(wage),
      mean_2014_wage,
      wage
    )
  ) |>
  select(-mean_2014_wage)

# -- Repeat the fixed 2013 covariates over the 2014–2019 analysis years

county_covariates <- baseline_covariates |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    year = analysis_years
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year)
  ) |>
  arrange(
    county_fips,
    year
  )

```



```{r chain_categorization_panel_build, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# ---- Create categories

supermarket_chains <- c(
  "chain_ingles_markets",
  "chain_winn-dixie",
  "chain_stop_&_shop",
  "chain_albertsons",
  "chain_fred_meyer",
  "chain_trader_joes",
  "chain_trader_joe_s",
  "chain_whole_foods",
  "chain_save_a_lot",
  "chain_aldi",
  "chain_save_mart",
  "chain_safeway",
  "chain_kroger",
  "chain_giant_food",
  "chain_weis_markets",
  "chain_publix",
  "chain_supervalu",
  "chain_raleys",
  "chain_raley_s",
  "chain_smart_&_final",
  "chain_wild_oats",
  "chain_meijer",
  "chain_giant_eagle",
  "chain_he_butt",
  "chain_stater_bros",
  "chain_roundys",
  "chain_roundy_s"
)

club_store_chains <- c("chain_costco", "chain_sams_club", "chain_sam_s_club", "chain_bjs")
convenience_chains <- c("chain_seven_eleven", "chain_circle_k", "chain_speedway")
multi_category_chains <- c("chain_wal-mart", "chain_target")

entry_outcome_columns <- c(
  "chain_dollar_general_entry",
  "chain_dollar_tree_entry",
  "chain_family_dollar_entry",
  "chain_super_market_entry",
  "chain_convenience_store_entry",
  "chain_multi_category_entry",
  "chain_medium_grocery_entry",
  "chain_small_grocery_entry",
  "chain_produce_entry",
  "chain_farmers_market_entry"
)

stock_outcome_columns <- c(
  "chain_dollar_general_count",
  "chain_dollar_tree_count",
  "chain_family_dollar_count",
  "chain_nods_count"
)

# ---- Create the complete county-year panel

county_year_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  county_fips = county_scope$county_fips,
  year = as.integer(analysis_years)
)

# ---- Collapse detailed chains into broader retailer categories

snap_grouped <- snap_first_authorization |>
  mutate(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    authorization_year = as.integer(authorization_year),
    chain = case_when(
      chain %in% supermarket_chains ~ "chain_super_market",
      chain %in% club_store_chains ~ "chain_club_store",
      chain %in% convenience_chains ~ "chain_convenience_store",
      chain %in% multi_category_chains ~ "chain_multi_category",
      TRUE ~ chain
    )
  )

# ---- Count new retailer authorizations by county, chain, and year

entry_counts <- snap_grouped |>
  mutate(
    year = authorization_year,
    chain = paste0(chain, "_entry")
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(county_fips),
    !is.na(year),
    year %in% analysis_years
  ) |>
  count(
    county_fips,
    year,
    chain,
    name = "entry"
  )

# Add zero-valued observations so that every required outcome
# is present for every county-year

entry_zero_rows <- county_year_grid |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    chain = entry_outcome_columns
  ) |>
  mutate(
    entry = 0L
  )

# Combine the observed entries and zero-valued observations

entry_panel <- bind_rows(
  entry_zero_rows,
  entry_counts
) |>
  group_by(
    county_fips,
    year,
    chain
  ) |>
  summarise(
    entry = sum(entry, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = chain,
    values_from = entry,
    values_fill = 0L) |>
  mutate(
      total_ds_entry =
      chain_dollar_general_entry +
      chain_dollar_tree_entry +
      chain_family_dollar_entry,
    state = as.integer(substr(county_fips, 1, 2))
  )

# ---- Construct the number of active stores in each county-year

store_stock_counts <- store_count |>
  mutate(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    year = as.integer(year),
    chain = paste0(chain, "_count"),
    count = as.integer(count),
    chain = case_when(
      chain == "chain_family_dollar_count" ~ chain,
      chain == "chain_dollar_general_count" ~ chain,
      chain == "chain_dollar_tree_count" ~ chain,
      TRUE ~ "chain_nods_count"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(county_fips),
    year %in% analysis_years
  ) |>
  group_by(
    county_fips,
    year,
    chain
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Again add zero-valued observations for every required stock outcome

stock_zero_rows <- county_year_grid |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    chain = stock_outcome_columns
  ) |>
  mutate(
    count = 0L
  )


store_stock_panel <- bind_rows(
  stock_zero_rows,
  store_stock_counts
) |>
  group_by(
    county_fips,
    year,
    chain
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = chain,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0L
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total_count =
      chain_dollar_general_count +
      chain_dollar_tree_count +
      chain_family_dollar_count
  )

# ---- Collapse monthly waiver observations to county-years

waiver_treatment <- generated_long |>
  transmute(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(FIPS),
    year = as.integer(YEAR),
    countyname = LOC,
    type = LOC_TYPE,
    waiver_scope = waiver_scope,
    treatment = 1L
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(county_fips),
    !is.na(year),
    year %in% analysis_years
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(
    county_fips,
    year
  ) |>
  summarise(
    countyname = first(countyname),
    type = first(type),
    waiver_scope = if_else(
      any(waiver_scope == "statewide", na.rm = TRUE),
      "statewide",
      "substate"
    ),
    treatment = 1L,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- Merge treatment and retailer outcomes onto the balanced panel

county_names <- county |>
  transmute(
    county_fips = normalize_fips(county_fips),
    countyname = county
  ) |>
  distinct()

analysis_panel <- county_year_grid |>
  left_join(
    county_names,
    by = "county_fips"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    entry_panel,
    by = c("county_fips", "year")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    store_stock_panel,
    by = c("county_fips", "year")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    waiver_treatment |>
      select(-countyname),
    by = c("county_fips", "year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    treatment = replace_na(treatment, 0L),
    waiver_scope = replace_na(waiver_scope, "none"),
    across(
      any_of(
        c(
          entry_outcome_columns,
          "total_ds_entry",
          stock_outcome_columns,
          "total_count"
        )
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

# ---- Identify the first post-2014 waiver year

event2 <- analysis_panel |>
  filter(
    treatment == 1L,
    year >= 2014L,
    type == "County"
  ) |>
  group_by(county_fips) |>
  summarise(
    eventYear2 = min(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


analysis_panel <- analysis_panel |>
  left_join(
    event2,
    by = "county_fips"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tau2 = year - eventYear2,
    treated = !is.na(eventYear2)
  )

rm(event2)

# ---- Add the fixed baseline covariates

analysis_panel <- analysis_panel |>
  left_join(
    county_covariates,
    by = c("county_fips", "year")
  ) |>
  arrange(
    county_fips,
    year
  )

analysis_panel |>
  arrange(county_fips, year) |>
  group_by(county_fips) |>
  summarise(
    eventYear2 = first(eventYear2),
    treatment_turns_off = if_else(
      is.na(eventYear2),
      FALSE,
      any(year >= eventYear2 & treatment == 0L)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  count(treatment_turns_off)


```

# Extensive Margin, Abraham and Sun - Not Yet Treated

```{r DiD_flow, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}

library(fixest)

# ---- Construct the LPM event-study sample

# The existing LPM pipeline retains only counties that eventually receive a
# waiver and keeps, at most, the three years before first waiver exposure.
# Never-treated counties are therefore not part of this benchmark sample.

did_sample <- analysis_panel |>
  mutate(
    rent = rent / 1000,
    medianInc = medianInc / 1000,
    ds_entry_indicator = as.integer(total_ds_entry > 0),
    chain_super_market_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_super_market_entry > 0),
    chain_convenience_store_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_convenience_store_entry > 0),
    chain_multi_category_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_multi_category_entry > 0),
    chain_medium_grocery_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_medium_grocery_entry > 0),
    chain_small_grocery_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_small_grocery_entry > 0),
    chain_produce_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_produce_entry > 0),
    chain_farmers_market_entry_indicator = as.integer(chain_farmers_market_entry > 0)
  ) |>
  filter(
    year %in% analysis_years,
    !is.na(eventYear2),
    tau2 >= -3,
    !is.na(num_households),
    !is.na(wage),
    !is.na(medianInc),
    !is.na(rent),
    !is.na(urate)
  )

did_sample |>
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    counties = n_distinct(county_fips),
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year)
  )


# The regression formula below matches the existing LPM pipeline. In this QMD,
# however, the five covariates are fixed at their 2013 values and repeated over
# time. County fixed effects will therefore absorb them. The regression can be
# estimated, but its numerical result should not be expected to exactly match
# the existing pipeline, which uses time-varying covariates.


# ---- Dollar-store entry

did_total_ds <- feols(
  ds_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Supermarket entry

did_super_market <- feols(
  chain_super_market_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Convenience-store entry

did_convenience_store <- feols(
  chain_convenience_store_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Multi-category-store entry

did_multi_category <- feols(
  chain_multi_category_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Medium-grocery entry

did_medium_grocery <- feols(
  chain_medium_grocery_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Small-grocery entry

did_small_grocery <- feols(
  chain_small_grocery_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Produce-store entry

did_produce <- feols(
  chain_produce_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Farmers-market entry

did_farmers_market <- feols(
  chain_farmers_market_entry_indicator ~
    sunab(eventYear2, year, ref.p = -1) +
    num_households + wage + medianInc + rent + urate |
    county_fips + year,
  data = did_sample,
  cluster = ~county_fips
)


# ---- Dynamic event-study plots

fixest::iplot(
  did_total_ds,
  main = "Dollar-store entry",
  xlab = "Years relative to first waiver exposure",
  ylab = "Estimated treatment effect",
  ref.line = 0
)

fixest::iplot(
  did_convenience_store,
  main = "Convenience-store entry",
  xlab = "Years relative to first waiver exposure",
  ylab = "Estimated treatment effect",
  ref.line = 0
)


# ---- Compare the average post-treatment effects across outcomes

etable(
  did_total_ds,
  did_super_market,
  did_convenience_store,
  did_multi_category,
  did_medium_grocery,
  did_small_grocery,
  did_produce,
  did_farmers_market,
  headers = c(
    "Dollar Stores",
    "Supermarkets",
    "Convenience Stores",
    "Multi Category",
    "Medium Grocery",
    "Small Grocery",
    "Produce",
    "Farmers Market"
  ),
  agg = "att",
  keep = "ATT"
)
```

# Extensive Margin, Callaway and Sant'anna

Conditional Parallel Trends: In the absence of first waiver exposure, treated and comparison counties would have followed parallel trends conditional on their 2013 characteristics.

I think a big issue here is the role that unemployment plays as a predictor of treatment - meaning that there is very little propensity score overlap between the treatment and control groups once I include the unemployment rate as a predictor. This means we have treated observations for which we do not have observably comparable counterfactuals.

```{r baseline_cs, echo= FALSE, warning = TRUE, message= FALSE}

library(did)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Construct the Callaway-Sant'Anna sample

cs_sample <- analysis_panel |>
  mutate(
    county_id = as.integer(county_fips),
    first_treat_year = if_else(
      is.na(eventYear2),
      0L,
      eventYear2
    ),
    ds_entry_indicator = as.integer(total_ds_entry > 0),
    chain_convenience_store_entry_indicator = as.integer(
      chain_convenience_store_entry > 0
    ),
    medianInc = medianInc / 1000,
    rent = rent / 1000
  ) |>
  filter(
    year %in% analysis_years,
    !is.na(num_households),
    !is.na(wage),
    !is.na(medianInc),
    !is.na(rent),
    !is.na(urate)
  )


# Show the number of counties in each first-treatment cohort before applying
# the first-period restriction.

cs_sample |>
  distinct(
    county_id,
    first_treat_year
  ) |>
  count(
    first_treat_year,
    name = "counties"
  )


# Because 2014 is the first observed year, counties first treated in 2014 have
# no pre-treatment observation. The `did` package drops these already-treated
# counties. Make that restriction explicit while retaining 2014 as the first
# observation for never-treated counties and counties treated in 2015 or later.

#cs_sample <- cs_sample |>
#  filter(
#    first_treat_year == 0L |
#      first_treat_year > 2014L
#  )


# Verify that the retained county panel remains balanced.

cs_sample |>
  count(
    county_id,
    name = "years_observed"
  ) |>
  count(
    years_observed,
    name = "counties"
  )


# ---- Dollar-store entry

cs_dollar_stores <- did::att_gt(
  yname = "ds_entry_indicator",
  tname = "year",
  idname = "county_id",
  gname = "first_treat_year",
  xformla = ~ 
    num_households +
    wage +
    medianInc +
    rent,
   # urate,
  data = cs_sample,
  panel = TRUE,
  control_group = "notyettreated",

)

cs_dollar_stores_event <- did::aggte(

)

summary(cs_dollar_stores_event)

cs_dollar_stores_plot <- did::ggdid(

) +
  labs(

   # subtitle = "Callaway-Sant'Anna event study",
```

## Extensive Margin Poisson DiD

```{r ext_poissonDiD_dollar, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}

library('etwfe')

poisson_sample <- cs_sample |>
    filter(
    first_treat_year == 0L |
      first_treat_year > 2014L
  )

dollar_poisson_extensive <- etwfe(
   fml = ds_entry_indicator ~ num_households + wage + medianInc + rent,
  tvar = year,
  gvar = first_treat_year,
  data = poisson_sample,
  cgroup = "never",
  family = "poisson",
  vcov = ~county_id
)

dollar_poisson_att_extensive <- emfx(
  dollar_poisson_extensive,
  type = "simple",
  predict = "response"
)

dollar_poisson_att_extensive

dollar_poisson_event_extensive <- emfx(
  dollar_poisson_extensive,
  type = "event",
  predict = "response",
  post_only = FALSE
)

dollar_poisson_event_extensive

plot(dollar_poisson_event_extensive)
```

## Outstanding Problem: Repeated Record ID with different authorization years

```{r repeated_record_ID, echo= FALSE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
repeated_record_dates <- snap |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`Record ID`),
    !is.na(`Authorization Date`)
  ) |>
  group_by(`Record ID`) |>
  filter(
    n_distinct(`Authorization Date`) > 1
  ) |>
  mutate(
    number_of_authorization_dates = n_distinct(`Authorization Date`)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(
    desc(number_of_authorization_dates),
    `Record ID`,
    `Authorization Date`
  ) |>
  select(
    `Record ID`,
    `Store Name`,
    `Store Type`,
    County,
    State,
    `Authorization Date`,
    `End Date`,
    number_of_authorization_dates
  )
```
